title: Flare, creativity, unique style and pure talent
text:
The tour started with a great explanation of street art and graffiti, and its types of styles. A 2hr tour took us though the El
borne and Gothic area, viewing art from local to global artists.
Mike our guide showed great passion and knowledge of the local area and its artists. We also had the pleasure to meet 2x local artists and view their work space.
Barcelona has its own unique style and a must see tour.
Mike is the perfect guide
Thank you
Ps we took the walking tour
author: garyhN708JJ

title: Urban Art Town Hall on Two Wheels
text: It is a great way to see Barcelona from other angles, and get a sense of its cultural underpinnings. The mix of beach cures and downtown core is interesting.
author: Paul_B

title: Fantastic Street Art Tour! A must-do experience, even if you are in Barcelona for only one day.
text: Fantastic tour and one of the best experiences we had during our two days in Barcelona. Went with my 26 year old son who had been to Barcelona before but fell in love with the city after this tour. Mike is extremely knowledgeable, personable and passionate, and the art and history were absolutely fascinating. In the US we often think of tagging as vandalism but in Barcelona it is truly an art form worthy of admiration. This was 90 minutes very well spent walking through historic neighborhoods and appreciating contemporary street art amongst a backdrop of ancient architecture and world culture.
author: KimNV

title: Great way to see many...
text: Great way to see many different parts of Barcelona, off the beaten track. Amazing street art of course. And our guide Mike was great!
author: Gabriella_G

title: Great art, great guide, great exercise!
text: The bike tour was an easy ride and let us cover a lot of ground, visiting neighborhoods and learning about how an artist progresses in the workings time.  So many, many things we could not have found on our own. Mike is both enthusiastic and knowledgeable. He was a wonderful host.
author: Penny_K

title: Discover el raval differently
text:
A very nice walk , punctuated by anecdotes and crazy laughs.
MIKE shared his passion for street art with us with enthusiasm and pedagogy.
A different vision of the streets of Barcelona.
A big thank you.
author: Seaside41487738024

text: The Barcelona Street Style Tour was absolutely fantastic! We started at a local and legendary meeting point 🤫 Then we got to see many different graffiti’s and the stories of artists behind them. I recommend this experience to anyone who’s looking to know downtown Barcelona from a local and street art perspective. The value that Mike provides is rooted in years of dedication and genuine curiosity about the street art scene, you can’t Chat GPT your way into that!
author: sheylas614

text: I got lucky and had a private tour with Mike!  He was charming, passionate, funny and very well informed and we had a wonderful time strolling about the Born area.  He even introduced me to some of the artists we met along the way!  Because of his keen eye I noticed things I’d once overlooked and will never take for granted again.  What a treasure!
author: dareshak

title: A Must-Do tour for anyone visiting Barcelona!
text: Had a great time on this street art tour in Barcelona!  Booking the tour was extremely easy.  I happened to reach Mike on IG and he responded quickly and answered all of our questions.  Mike was friendly, very funny,  informative,  and knowledgable about the street art in Poblenou.  We biked from Barri Gotic to Poblenou and back and went along the beach path which was an added bonus.   Be prepared to pay cash in euros or use Zelle. title: You must do this!! Fantastic.
text:
We had a fantastic time with Mike on the tour, saw art we would have never spotted otherwise and we can still see new ones now.
Culture, history and art all rolled into one.
Cherry on the top, doing it for yourself, with Henderson, no skill or talent required, fabulous fun and really pleased with the final wall.
Great value for money, it's you and your bit of wall, not the mass sharing that near us.
We'd do it all again given the chance.
